replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

You have to understand that the situation in which you used the term "Vicewaterfucker" was not a joke. 
The phrase "Remember you are on a Jr Mod trial," is not a threat. It's a wake-up call to remind you that your behaviour is being monitored and will affect your outcome as a staff member.

Saying "Vicewaterfucker" is not acceptable, even if it is a joke, especially in your case.



Your behaviour in this appeal is unacceptable. Change it for future appeals.
This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Midnight
